definitions.explanation: The flat, green part of a plant. A casual/childish variant of 葉 (は).

examples.japanese: {葉|は}っぱ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{葉|は}っぱ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing with leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葉|は}っぱ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: The leaves turn red in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{葉|は}っぱ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing by collecting leaves in the park.

notes:
{葉|は}っぱ is a casual/colloquial variant of ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧ (leaf). The っぱ suffix creates a friendly, informal tone.

REGISTER COMPARISON:
- {葉|は}っぱ: casual, childlike, conversational
- ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧: standard, neutral, written

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {葉|は}っぱ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: leaves fall
- {葉|は}っぱ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect leaves
- {葉|は}っぱ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play with leaves

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧: fallen leaves
- ⟦{青葉|あおば}→青葉：20092_aoba⟧: green leaves (fresh spring/summer foliage)
- ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧/⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧: autumn leaves, fall foliage
- ⟦{枯|か}れ{葉|は}→枯れ葉：20386_kareha⟧: dead/withered leaves

USAGE:
{葉|は}っぱ is commonly used when speaking to or around children, but adults use it casually too.
